newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends up 1.1 vs dlr at 1,072.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends up 1.1 vs dlr at 1,072.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed up 1.1 pesos against the dollar at 1,072.00 in active trading on the country's interbank market, dealers said.

They said sales of U.S. currency by banks and the corporate sector helped lift the peso off its intraday low of 1,073.80. But the trading session saw firm resistance for the peso at its high for the day of 1,071.00, dealers said.
They reported 402 trades for a total of $178 million and said there was no consensus on the outlook for the peso in trading next week.
